evidence.quote: | NetEndOfMonth days -> let endOfMonth = DateOnly(issueDate.Year, issueDate.Month, DateTime.DaysInMonth(...)) ... endOfMonth.AddDays days
| true, (true, days) when days > 0 && days <= 365 -> Ok(Some(NetEndOfMonth days))

ARC-REV-01.rationale: The due-date rule and the wording both live in Summa.Ledger (Tier 1). The storage codec is in Summa.Storage (Tier 2), and parsing and validating the customer form's input is in Summa.Web.Engine (Tier 2). The change touches no Tier 3 or Tier 4 code except the help text in app/index.html, which holds no rule.

ARC-REV-02.rationale: The change adds no effect. DateTime.DaysInMonth is a pure calendar calculation, not a clock read. The due date comes from the issue date passed in, and the codec builds Json values as data.

ARC-REV-03.rationale: The 'Net N EOM' wording is written out twice, in Documents.termsText and in the audit trail's termsWords, instead of one function both call. The 1-to-365 range check is copied from the existing Net branch into the new EOM branch. The copies agree today, so this is a restatement, not a contradiction. It follows the pattern the existing Net wording already used.

evidence.quote: | DayOfNextMonth day -> let nextMonth = issueDate.AddMonths 1 ... DateOnly(nextMonth.Year, nextMonth.Month, day)

ARC-REV-01.rationale: The valid-day rule, the due-date rule and the wording are all defined in Summa.Ledger (Tier 1). Storage (Tier 2) and the engine's form parser (Tier 2) call isDayOfNextMonth instead of deciding the range themselves. The change adds no rule in Tier 3 or Tier 4.

ARC-REV-02.rationale: The change adds no effect. The date arithmetic works on the issue date passed in, and storage encodes and decodes as pure data.

evidence.quote: let dayOfNextMonthText (day: int) = $"Due the {dayOrdinal day} of next month"
if isDayOfNextMonth day then Ok(DayOfNextMonth day) else Error ...
| true, (true, day) when isDayOfNextMonth day -> Ok(Some(DayOfNextMonth day))

ARC-REV-03.rationale: Each new fact has one definition that every use references. The 1-to-28 range is isDayOfNextMonth, used by both the storage decoder and the form parser. The wording is dayOfNextMonthText, used by both Documents.termsText and the audit trail's termsWords. The ordinal suffix is dayOrdinal. The 'Net N EOM' duplication from change set 1 is still there, but this change does not touch it.
